assumptions.statement: Official boundaries, regulatory controls, road and rail redlines, ownership, heritage controls, utilities and engineering constraints are not present in the public package.
assumptions.impact: All geometry beyond the supplied provisional constraints is a conceptual reference scheme and must be recalculated before statutory or engineering use.

assumptions.statement: No measured building inventory or structural assessment is available.
assumptions.impact: Prototype footprints describe spatial relationships only; no parcel-level retain, renovate or demolish decision is claimed.

assumptions.statement: The open corridor and five transverse thresholds have not been tested against detailed rail, traffic, fire, loading and accessibility information.
assumptions.impact: Alignment, width, speed and facility size remain conceptual until specialist review.

assumptions.statement: A shared mission ID, six-seat mission table and public receipt can reduce fragmentation across the three Key Areas.
assumptions.impact: Pilot operating tests should precede major capital investment; inability to create cross-area mission flow is a reversal trigger.

assumptions.statement: Talent attraction is more durable when mission opportunity, family life, public trust and contribution are designed together.
assumptions.impact: Evaluate resident benefit, talent retention, opt-out quality and public-service pressure together rather than relying on visitor counts.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual green and public-space ratios are calculated against a provisional rough boundary without an existing-tree, ecology or stormwater survey.
assumptions.impact: The ratios are design evidence for this submission only and are not statutory planning indicators.
